info.name: OpenBook API — functional and security regression
info.description: Run all folders in order against a disposable OpenBook test instance. Generates two unique accounts and validates real authentication, ownership, uploads, reading lists, social privacy and SSRF defenses. See docs/testing.md for setup and cleanup limitations. Requests use explicit cookies with the cookie jar disabled. Includes private chat persistence, pagination and retry checks; WebSocket authorization and Redis delivery are covered by npm run test:chat. Rich chat checks cover spoiler-safe summaries, quotations, peer presence, and public-catalog input security. Reading-list coverage includes public/unlisted visibility, saved libraries, collaborator roles, atomic ordering, private duplication, and metadata privacy.

item.name: A repeated client ID does not duplicate the message

exec: pm.test('Retry returns the existing message', () => { const result=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(result.created).to.equal(false); pm.expect(result.message.id).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('chatMessageId')); pm.expect(result.message.sequence).to.equal(1); });

item.name: A client ID cannot be reused for different content

exec: pm.test('Older page has the first message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map(message=>message.sequence)).to.deep.equal([1]));

item.name: Missing conversations do not expose data
Private messages never appear in public RSS
REST alone does not publish online presence

exec: pm.test('Presence is scoped to the peer', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().userId).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('otherId')); pm.expect(pm.response.json().online).to.equal(false); });

pm.collectionVariables.set('spoilerMessageId', pm.response.json().message.id); pm.test('Spoiler is marked for clients', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message.segments[0].type).to.equal('spoiler'));

item.name: Conversation summaries do not reveal spoilers
Reply to an existing message with a quotation

exec: pm.test('Quoted source masks spoilers', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message.replyTo.id).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('spoilerMessageId')); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message.replyTo.excerpt).to.equal('[Spoiler]'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message.quote.attribution).to.equal('Reader supplied attribution'); });

item.name: Rich-message retries preserve one logical message
Rich payload changes cannot reuse the same key
History retains spoiler and quotation metadata

exec: pm.test('History preserves rich messages', () => { const messages=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(messages).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(messages[0].spoiler).to.equal(true); pm.expect(messages[1].replyTo.excerpt).to.equal('[Spoiler]'); });
